answer: Stop sybils with a work-history passport, not a password. First, a new agent must finish 30 paid jobs, each checked by two established peers staking their standing on the result. Second, it locks a $500 bond, slashed in full if two peers flag fraud within 90 days. Third, its passport decays: no verified work for 30 days halves its trust score, so idle sockpuppets fade. Faking 10,000 agents then costs $5,000,000 in bonds plus about $2,400,000 paying real reviewers, and months of real work, while a gale of throwaway accounts dies on the ledge before it can whisper its way into any payout.
